title: Return Address
flavor_text: Each parcel contains the label for the next parcel; stop when a label points home.
content: Start with label 5. Rule A maps 5 to E. Rule B takes E and maps its alphabet index to C. Rule C takes C and maps it to H. Rule D takes H and maps it to O, which points back to the home marker. Record outputs in traversal order and stop at the base marker.
notes: Synthetic recursive meta with an explicit base case.
